title: Distributional Analysis — implementation
summary: Reveal who wins and loses under a model by breaking outcomes down across income deciles, age cohorts, regions and household types, with honest, uncertainty-aware visualisations. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: A model's outcomes are broken down across all four dimensions
Distributional results are visualised clearly with uncertainty shown
Breakdowns are sourced/caveated and consistent with aggregate totals
Fairness / Poverty scores can optionally incorporate distribution
notes:
Scope (in): Income deciles; Age cohorts; Regional impacts; Household types; Distribution visualisations
Out of scope: The underlying channel modelling (EPIC-012); Monte Carlo over distributions (EPIC-014)
